newsitem.title: USA: Aon says to acquire Alexander & Alexander.
newsitem.headline: Aon says to acquire Alexander & Alexander.

text.p: Aon Corp said Wednesday it entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Alexander & Alexander Services Inc for $17.50 in cash per common share, plus considerations for Alexander's preferred shares.
The agreement was approved unanimously by the boards of both the major insurance and consulting concerns, Aon said.

The total transaction is valued at roughly $1.23 billion, taking into account the $790 million cash tender offer for the common stock, the $120 million conversion value of Alexander & Alexander's Series A preferred stock and the $317.5 million purchase price for its Series B preferred stock, Aon said.

The tender offer for the common shares is expected to commence no later than December 16, Aon said. The tender offer will not extend to the Class A and C common shares of Alexander & Alexander, Aon said.

Alexander & Alexander chairman and chief executive Frank Zarb said, "A&A has chosen to merge with the premier company in the business. With the combined strengths of both organizations, the new Aon will shape the future of this industry ... The need for consolidation has been increasingly evident in recent years."

Chicago-based Aon is an insurance giant that in October completed a $250-million acquisition of Bain Hogg Group Inc, an insurance brokerage, from Inchcape Plc. The deal was seen then by insurance industry analysts as sparking a wave of consolidation among international insurance brokers.
Alexander & Alexander, based in New York, is a major insurance services and human resources consulting firm.
